title: Yeasty Ethiopian Ground Allspice Tagine
description: A rich, yeasty, and aromatic Ethiopian-inspired dish featuring ground allspice, ground beef, and Mediterranean flavors, perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground beef to the pan and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the ground allspice, salt, black pepper, and paprika to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the shio cure and yeast to the pan and stir to combine.
Gradually add the flour and water to the pan, stirring to combine and form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a ball. Place the ball on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the tagine for 25-30 minutes, or until it is golden brown and cooked through.
Let the tagine cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Enjoy your yeasty Ethiopian ground allspice tagine!
Consider serving with a side of injera or flatbread for a more authentic experience.
